name: GAMA Platform
description: GAMA Platform is an open-source agent-based modeling and simulation environment for building spatially explicit multi-agent systems. It enables researchers and experts to model, visualize, and experiment with complex interactions in ecology, urban planning, social sciences, and resource management using the GAML language.
reputation: Widely respected open-source platform used globally in academic research, education, and participatory modeling of complex systems.
notes: Highly extensible but requires programming expertise; supports very large-scale simulations with strong visualization tools.
